description: R1-frontier Astra token probe: GPT-6 Astra on ONE out-of-panel smoke maze (S4 10x10 dense, navigation only, 30 optimal steps — the simplest smoke maze) with the exact run_config.r1_frontier.json model params (xhigh, 64k, flex, image_detail=high). NOT a scored panel.
